title: Balancing and finite coefficient comparisons by fully faithful restriction
statement: Fix l,E,j,o as in [def-sf-open-tensor-quotient-data]. Every pair of completed-coefficient complexes P,Q admits the Balanced coefficient isomorphism, with the full formula placing the coefficient in the first tensor factor. Given any two such balancing isomorphisms on (j_!Q,F) and (Q,j^*F), a fixed signed ordinary total-tensor comparison tc, scalar compatibility sc and scalar reduction comparison r, there are gamma and finiteGamma with exactly the finiteGammaRestriction and reduction equations of StrictSquare. No scalar-unit augmentation, augmented square or Roos normalization is part of this assertion.

source.place: Tag 0E8I, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; scalar extension and restriction, Tags 03DI and 03EK; strict systems, Tag 0941. Strict cochain specialization.

proof.text: Specialize the existing normalizedIntegralTensorTower to the global slice, identifying its tower with the unrestricted reduction tower. Its coefficient formula is exactly Balanced.coefficients and gives balanced_nonempty.

Define gamma by conjugating the fixed integral chain comparison through the two balancing isomorphisms and r: bX inverse, reduction of tc.chain, r, and extension of bU. Cancel bX to obtain reduction as an equality of tower maps, then evaluate at each level and degree.

The completed coefficient projection is locally surjective. Consequently restriction of scalars on sheaf modules is full (local lifts show that completed-linear maps are finite-linear) and faithful, and so is its induced functor on complexes. At each finite level n, compose gamma_n with the inverse of the complex comparison induced by sc.finite n. Lift this isomorphism uniquely through fully faithful scalar restriction. These lifts are finiteGamma. The map-preimage equation followed by cancellation of the inverse scalar comparison proves finiteGammaRestriction. No compatibility beyond the strict gamma tower is required in the finiteGamma field.
